description: Central registry for every project asset. Initialised empty: no assets have been imported yet. Companion human-readable view: ASSET_INDEX.md. Submission process: ASSET_SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md.
id_format: ELWH-<CATEGORY>-<NNNN>  (e.g. ELWH-CHR-0001). IDs are unique and never reused, even if an asset is rejected or deprecated.

categories.REF: Reference material (owner-supplied; never ships in game)

status_lifecycle.proposed: Submitted for consideration. Not canon, not usable in production.
status_lifecycle.in-review: Under active review by the project owner or delegated reviewer.
status_lifecycle.approved: Accepted for use. May still receive new versions.
status_lifecycle.approved-master: Locked master asset. NEVER overwrite without explicit owner authorisation (AGENTS.md rule 6).
status_lifecycle.rejected: Not accepted. Kept on record only if the owner requests retention.
status_lifecycle.deprecated: Formerly approved, now superseded by a newer asset ID.

entry_schema.title: Human-readable asset title
entry_schema.category: One of the category codes in 'categories'
entry_schema.file: Path to the primary file, relative to repository root
entry_schema.source_files: Array of paths to preserved originals (PSD/KRA/Aseprite/WAV…), [] if none
entry_schema.author_or_source: Creator name, toolchain honestly disclosed, or external source URL
entry_schema.license: Licence/usage terms for externally sourced material, else 'project-owned'
entry_schema.dimensions: e.g. '2048x2048' or null when not applicable
entry_schema.notes: Pivots, frame counts, palette scripts, related asset IDs, validation results
